newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin down 13 cents to 14.36 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin down 13 cents to 14.36 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 13 cents to close at 14.36 ringgit ($5.79) a kg after tracking an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was a large offering after the fall on the LME, and this took the local market down," said a trader.
Offers outnumbered bids by 163 tonnes to 78, leading to a final turnover of 131 tonnes compared with 101 on Tuesday.
Buyers were Europeans, Japanese and locals. The premium against the London market widened to $35 a tonne from $25 previously.
